Name: Mordred Fate - Sam replacement
Author: Stormvictor
Description:
I really wanted to play Stardew Valley with some of my favourite Servants from Fate/grand order and I thought I'd share what I've worked on! I'm new to making mods and pixel art, but I hope you enjoy!

For the portrait I used the main art of Mordred from FGO as inspiration for the pixel portrait, and I tried to keep it as close to Stardew's art style as I could.

Manifest.Description: Reskin of Sam into Mordred from FGO
